name: 天坛公园
experience_value: Supports first-visit routes that need a second imperial logic different from the Forbidden City.
Adds ceremonial architecture and open-axis calm without repeating palace storytelling beat for beat.
Helps student routes carry cultural weight in a more breathable way than another dense museum block.
avoid_when: the route is intentionally avoiding major symbolic landmarks
the day already contains a long imperial-core walk and needs a more casual neighborhood texture instead
the traveler wants a highly contemporary or food-led day with minimal ceremonial tone
